revision: Rev A, CAD parameter file v0 (2026-10-15): core/grate/plenum from the lane files; separator, cap, bosses, guard and hardware provisional from 03-architecture.md pending the cap/mech lanes
units: mm; axes X along fins (across the lines), Y along the lines, Z up from the die face (z=0 at datum A); origin at the fin-field centre

notes.stack_z: die face 0 | base 0..0.85 | fins 0.85..2.80 | grate land plate 2.80..4.10 | meter web 4.10..4.50 | plenum 4.50..10.30 | separator 10.30..12.10 | cap lid 12.10..13.10 | arches to 21.10 (architecture said 20.80 with a 1.5 mm separator; the plenum lane chose 1.8 mm: +0.3 mm, flagged)
notes.grate_outline: grate lane says 122.6 square; core lane recommends 121.0 to sit inside the rim (121.4 outer) and clear the cap skirt; v0 uses 121.0 and flags it
notes.datum_pins: core lane: 2.0 H7 pins at (+/-57.5, +/-57.5); grate lane: 3.0 hole/slot at (+/-57, +/-57); v0 follows the core (2.0 at +/-57.5) and flags it
notes.kerf: modelled full depth over the whole fin length; the saw run-out ramp (full depth only for |y| <= 48.1) is not modelled
notes.capillary_grooves: 0.15 x 0.08 laser scribes on the land plate are not modelled

separator.material: OFE C10100 (316L 0.6 option rejected by the plenum lane)

outlet_windows.at_lines: out and edge_out (edge: w_x 2.5 at x +/-53.7)

separator.source: windows 5.0 x 8.0 per IR-C1 in design/DDD-cap.md section 3 / params-cap.json (cap lane design of record, 2026-10-16); outline 121.0 per IR-C2; outlet window y positions follow the 4 outlet arches

cap.source: design/DDD-cap.md section 3 / params-cap.json (cap lane design of record, 2026-10-16)
cap.material: OFE C10100 1.00 sheet, O60, drawn (arches first, then skirt, then restrike)

skirt.lap_on_rim: inner face on the core rim lap face 121.40 (x 60.7) from z 1.5 (land) to 2.8 (rim top); radial gap 0.05; land exposed 0.8 outboard of the skirt
skirt.clearance_to_stack: grate / web / separator outline 121.0 -> 0.25; plenum flange 0.24 (CAD bbox 60.51); frames 0.40

tap_notches.note: skirt notched over the two core tap bosses (8 wide to z 2.8); notch edges brazed to the boss

arches.end_shape: vertical end, plan radius internal 5.0 / external 6.0 (half cup: full-round slot ends)

cross_domes.section: same wall and crown radii as the arches (internal h 7.7, crown r_i 3.5 / r_e 4.5)

outlet_spine.note: joins the outlet dome to arch 4 across the valley y 41..43 (external); modelled from inside the dome crown flat to the arch-4 centre line so that its end faces lie inside the neighbouring cavities

cross_domes.note: drawn domes that join the arches under each port boss; w_x and span_y are internal

port_pockets.note: modelled as d26.1 openings through the 1.0 dome crown (z 19.8..20.8); the boss pilot d25.95 x 1.0 closes them with its underside at the internal crown z 19.8

bosses.source: design/DDD-cap.md section 3 / params-cap.json (cap lane design of record, 2026-10-16), section 5

pilot.into: cap port pocket d26.10 (radial braze gap 0.05-0.10)

bosses.interface: stub seat counterbore d23 H8 x 8.0 deep with a face O-ring groove 1.3 x 0.75 at d20.3-21.6 (not modelled); 316L stub 20/23 x 30 pressed and lip-rolled

guard.source: design/DDD-cap.md section 3 / params-cap.json (cap lane design of record, 2026-10-16), section 6 (GUARD-C)
guard.material: 316L square weave 50 um absolute (270 mesh, 0.041 wire), 0.5 mm 316L frame ring and collar
guard.shape: inverted cup d30 x 5.0 under the inlet dome crown, centred on the inlet boss; corrugated bottom not modelled

collar.note: rises through the d20 opening into the inlet boss bore (hook tabs not modelled)

guard.note: modelled as a 0.1 mm shell hanging from the inlet dome crown (z 14.8..19.8): mesh wall d30 to z 19.3, mesh top annulus, 0.5 frame ring d28 against the crown underside (d28, not d30, so that it clears the r 3.5 crown fillet whose ceiling is z 19.65 at r 15). params-cap.json places the cup on four 2.0 feet at z 14.1..19.1; the CAD follows the task note (hanging, 14.8..19.8). Alternative GUARD-A (25 cm2 pleated element in a d34 x 40 housing on the inlet stub) is open item O-C3

frame.note: backplate/load frame under the TTV for the render; mech lane to define

ttv.material: AlN tiles on copper block (context only)
